//: Desktop-stack typecheck config for the ags-capture-tool package. HAND-WRITTEN
AND COMMITTED. `ags bundle` transpiles without type-checking, so this is the
gate that catches a type error before it becomes a runtime failure.
`ags types -d . -u` writes its OWN tsconfig.json at the repo root and
OVERWRITES it on every run, so this file deliberately uses a non-colliding
name. Do not rename it to tsconfig.json.
make types runs `ags types -d . -u` and generates the machine-specific
@girs/ + env.d.ts for THIS host; both are gitignored. The `ags`/`ags/*`
paths map makes the AGS runtime resolve for every file in the program,
including ags-platform adapters that import `ags/gtk4/app`.
resolveJsonModule is required by the platform's icon-registry adapter;
skipLibCheck skips identifier clashes in the generated GIR declarations.
`types: []` PINS THE AMBIENT-TYPE SURFACE TO EMPTY, ON PURPOSE. This app runs
under GJS, not Node. Without the pin, TypeScript auto-includes every
reachable @types/* package, which makes the app's ambient surface depend on
where a directory happens to live. tests/tsconfig.tests.json asks for node
types by name, as a separate project.
lib/ is NOT a generated or third-party layer here: it holds the pure
appearance/refresh cores. domain/, ports/ and lib/ import no `gi://*` and
no `ags/*`; the desktop-free part is exercised by tests/ts/typecheck-config.
